segments.say: G'day. This is ButterflyFx Podcast Creator, a studio that turns a script into a finished episode. Let me show you how it works.
First, I open the episode folder.
The script and every picture it needs load together.
Here's the script. The words in curly braces are cues, and each one fires on the word right after it.
Now the look. I'll make my studio the backdrop.
Then I just start talking. The teleprompter follows my voice, and keeps the current word right under the camera.
And that's the episode, recorded straight through. Save it as a video, and you're done. No post-production.
ButterflyFx Podcast Creator. Free, and open source.
